14.guidance: Grow permanent Undead attack and spend remaining slots on repeatable summons. Protect the scaling source until attack is established.

92.guidance: Develop shop scaling before investing heavily in the payoff. Battlecry economy supports the transition; a weak shop makes the payoff premature.

38.guidance: Start scaling Beetles early, then improve summon count and Deathrattle repetition. Keep immediate strength while the permanent counter grows.

13.guidance: Connect self-damage, protection and a payoff before cycling aggressively. Health is a constraint until the protection is active.

76.guidance: Establish repeatable economy before cycling shop buffs and consumption. This advisor does not certify an infinite-gold loop from card membership alone.

83.guidance: Pair the payoff with repeated Beast summons early enough to scale. Upgrade summon quality while preserving immediate combat strength.

41.guidance: Build shop stats before committing board slots to consumption. Compare the consumed stats with the immediate strength available in the shop.

91.guidance: Pair the magnetic trigger with targeted spells and a spell multiplier. Keep board and hand space to use the supply; the cards alone do not guarantee repeatable resources.

87.guidance: Assemble repeated Deathrattle triggers and their payoff. Preserve the necessary support pieces while upgrading temporary bodies.

8.guidance: Use venom and defensive utility as a survival pivot when ordinary scaling cannot catch up. Positioning and the opponent composition still matter.

3.guidance: Use bounty economy to feed the Undead payoff. Keep enough space and time to execute the sequence; unsupported loops remain uncertain.

67.guidance: A Battlecry multiplier and the payoff need a continuing resource supply. Do not treat two expensive cards as a complete engine.

89.guidance: Develop the economy that feeds the golden payoff before committing. A high-action loop also requires enough recruit time to execute it.

12.guidance: Assemble summon buffs with Deathrattle triggers and repetition. Keep a playable board during the transition rather than buying every final-board piece.

88.guidance: Connect the Choose One engine and payoff, then scale the resources they consume. Replace temporary bodies only when the engine can sustain them.

15.guidance: Pair Dragon scaling with the Battlecry multiplier and a supply of Battlecries. Keep board space for cycling and enough health to survive the transition.
